$Comment:
What Enchanting means at the lesser Disenchanting Table. It extends the jar's Disenchant action through the SCOPED target {Station: Disenchanting_Table, Action: Disenchant}, so it reaches that action on that one station and nowhere else. An extension's additions never flow down a Parent chain, so the greater table's own action (Disenchant_Greater, a child of Disenchant) never sees this file: DisenchantingGreaterProgression.json is a Parent child of this one that changes only its Target, so the two tables share one set of numbers and a retune here reaches both.

Four things, nothing else: the jar owns the ritual, its presentation, its custody and its recipe, and this pack owns only what progression means at it.

(1) PerCycleContributions. One cycle is one whole ritual (one piece unmade, 15 to 40 seconds), so each amount is per piece, not per few seconds the way the Sawmill's are. ENCHANTING counts full and CRAFTING half, the station's own skill full and the adjacent one half. Both post on mmoskilltree:skill_xp (Param is the skill id), which the MMO bridge awards as skill XP.

(2) ContributionScale. The jar's Disenchant action authors none, so this one stands alone and multiplies the two amounts above before they are posted, from the piece on the table: item level at 1, quality at 5 per step, durability at a tenth per percent (a worn piece reads lower) and stamped enhancement points at a half each (an enhanced piece reads higher). The highest floor reached wins; below the first floor the scale is 1. A crude piece stays at 1, an iron piece reaches 1.25, the cobalt to adamantite band 1.5, a mithril piece 2 and an enhanced mithril piece 2.5. If the jar ever authors its own ContributionScale, remember that an extension's Factors and Floors each replace the action's whole array.

(3) Pace. A trained enchanter works faster as well as luckier. This ladder over the Enchanting level is its own complete ladder: its scale MULTIPLIES the jar action's proficiency ladder and the action's own Clamp bounds the product, which keeps every ritual between 15 and 40 seconds, so there is no Clamp to author here. Level 100 with nothing else on brings the three paced beats to 0.6 of their length (about 26 seconds a ritual); with the disenchanter's kit and its set on as well, about 19; with the Disenchanter's Grimoire in hand too, the 15-second floor.

(4) Bonus.Lootables names only the tables this pack ADDS: Mmo_Disenchant_Essence_Pay (more Life essence, sized by luck), Mmo_Disenchant_Salvage_Extras (now and then more of the salvage return's main material) and Mmo_Disenchant_Void_Finds (luck-weighted Void finds). The pack also ships Disenchant_Kit.json and DisenchantTrophy.json, which carry the ids of tables the jar's action already lists, so they replace the jar's versions in place; listing either here would roll it twice.

Every number here is balance data and retunes by editing this one file.
